newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Finance Ministry and the National Bank of Hungary proposes the abolition of a hard currency exchange limit for private individuals as of January 1.
- The Energy Association has called for the halting of energy sector privatisation.
- Privatisation Agency APV Rt will foot the bill for an extra 4.5 percent pay rise at the privatised energy utilities.
- Tne new national police chief said police officers should receive higher wages.
- Romanian press reports praise Hungary's ruling coalition and slam the opposition over Tuesday's vote on the Hungarian-Romanian basic treaty.
